# SUPERSEDED CONVENTIONS. This fixture was labelled before ADR-0010 and the criterion revision
# of 2026-09-22. The rows are never rewritten — they are the artifact — but the families below
# were labelled under rules the criterion no longer holds, so a session pricing a candidate rule
# against the accumulated labels treats them as evidence-free rather than as costs:
#   - A title carrying both an off-domain marker and a software qualifier. The old step 4 let
#     every marker beat the qualifier; a market marker no longer does.
#   - A hardware-adjacent code role (fpga, asic, rtl, gnc, emulation, signal processing). Q2 and
#     Q4 were unranked and three labellers split the family three ways; the discipline marker
#     decides it now.
#   - A domain-free head with a market modifier (Treasury Analyst, Management Analyst). Labellers
#     resolved these on judgement; the criterion says they are unknown.
#   - A post that hires nobody (talent community, general application, refer a friend). The Q1
